name: Dramatic Deep Dive
description: Full-Kanto Deep Dive preview with deliberately expanded underwater geography: open ocean and Cinnabar use 3x horizontal scale (9x swim area), coasts, harbors and major underwater caves use 2x scale, while inland freshwater remains close to Kanto scale. HM08 is given unconditionally by a fixed researcher outside, just left of the Cinnabar Lab. Includes continuous water under bridges and pontoons, visible-only Wilds encounters, seamless underwater connections, biome-aware geology, Pokedex-scaled wildlife, salvage and HM08 DIVE.
